title: docs(spec): the lookup picker reads its seven keys camelCase-only (docblock + six liveness notes)
body:
Fixes #23012
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Prose only. No schema, `.describe()`, key or accepted value changes.

- `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`: the docblock above the lookup picker keys was headed "SNAKE_CASE TOLERANCE". It said objectui reads `lookupColumns`, `lookupPageSize` and `allowCreate` as `snake ?? camel` and called them "the three aliases that survive". It now says the picker reads all seven keys camelCase-only. It keeps the history (objectui#7155, objectui#7357) and adds objectui#12157 as the round that retired the last three. It says a stored snake spelling is folded onto the declared key when the console ingests it (`normalizeSchemaReferenceKeys`). It still ends by pointing to the `lookupColumns` ledger row.
- `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`: the six lookup picker notes (`lookupColumns`, `lookupPageSize`, `allowCreate`, `descriptionField`, `lookupFilters`, `dependsOn`) drop their "(reads X || x)" tails. Each carries the reading at `objectui @daeb77fc84` and `verifiedAt: 2026-10-16`. Where a reader outside the picker keeps a snake leg behind the declared key, the note names it as a cited read point: `resolveActionParams.ts#resolveActionParam` for `description_field` / `lookup_filters`, and `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx#readLookupFilters` / `#readDependsOn` for `lookup_filters` / `depends_on`.
- `.changeset/23012-lookup-snake-tolerance-text.md`: a `patch` for `@objectstack/spec`. Its `files[]` ships both `src/**/*.zod.ts` and `liveness`, so both edits publish.

## The reading, at objectui `daeb77fc84dd824e74c95b87cdede85afdb248e7` (objectstack's `.objectui-sha`)

- `packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx` reads each of the seven keys camelCase-only, in `declaredDisplayField`, `descriptionField`, `explicitAllowCreate`, `lookupColumns`, `lookupPageSize`, `lookupFilters` and `dependsOn`. `displayField` keeps `reference_field` behind it. That is objectui's own leg, not a spec key. No snake read of any of the seven is left in that file.
- The fold holds as the card suggested. `packages/core/src/utils/reference-keys.ts#normalizeSchemaReferenceKeys` stamps an undeclared key onto the `FieldSchema` key that shares its alias probe (lowercased, separators removed). It never overwrites a declared value that is already there. `packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx` runs it over every stored `object` item.
- **Hypothesis 1 is only partly true.** Two readers outside the picker still rank a snake leg *behind* the declared key at the pin:
  - `packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts`, where a lookup action param is built: `descriptionField ?? description_field` and `lookupFilters ?? lookup_filters`.
  - `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` (`readLookupFilters`, `readDependsOn`): `lookupFilters ?? lookup_filters` and `dependsOn ?? depends_on`, as the designer's read of a stored document.

  So the docblock does not claim "no reader anywhere reads a snake spelling". It is scoped to the picker readers it already named (LookupField / RecordPickerDialog), where the claim holds. The surviving legs are recorded, dated, in the `lookupColumns` ledger row and in the rows of the keys they read. None is a spelling this schema declares.

## Acceptance notes

- The `descriptionField`, `lookupFilters` and `dependsOn` notes were first left out of scope. They joined this PR in the seat's patch round (card comment 6215181639) and were rewritten the same way as the other three.
